`mini.osm.pbf` — a hand-built OSM PBF (two OSMData blocks: dense nodes in a zlib blob, then a plain-node block with
custom granularity/offsets in a raw blob) generated by `tools/build-graph/pbf-fixture.ts` (`MINI_FIXTURE`). Synthetic data
(no OSM content): six Williamsburg-ish streets with node ids > 2^33, one sidewalk (dropped), one oneway, one unnamed
service road (dropped), one non-highway way. Regenerate with `UNFOG_WRITE_FIXTURES=1 npx vitest run tools/build-graph/pbf-reader.test.ts`;
the test asserts the file equals the builder's bytes.
